interpretation.strongest_supported_claim: V1 verifies scanner-recognized annotations that successfully correspond to compiler definitions under the selected invocation.
unsupported_stronger_claims: the scanner enumerates the same item set as rustc
scanner source paths are a universal compiler identity
all configured/generated/local compiler definitions are independently Anneal-annotatable
semantic reachability in Charon implies Anneal annotation/specification coverage
